TechFit (legal name: Techfit Health Fitness Private Limited) is India's premier end-to-end gym, wellness, sports recovery, longevity, and sports infrastructure company. Headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with certified engineers across all Indian metro cities, they have delivered 800+ complete gym, longevity, and wellness facilities across India since 2014.
